comment: DVB-S2 multiprotocol encapsulation: the sections of dvbs2/sections, of the `pid`, and each MPE datagram section's
header read and its CRC-32 checked: the datagram (an IP packet) a message, captured for Wireshark as raw IP.
Only MPE sections (table id 0x3E) are kept

pid.comment: the PID carrying the MPE sections (the PMT says which); -1: every PID's
